messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Character names referenced by offered choices: [{"characterId":"character:companion","name":"陆舟"}]. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Character names referenced by offered choices: [{"characterId":"character:companion","name":"陆舟"}]. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Character names referenced by offered choices: [{"characterId":"character:companion","name":"陆舟"},{"characterId":"character:friend","name":"程雨"}]. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Character names referenced by offered choices: [{"characterId":"character:companion","name":"陆舟"},{"characterId":"character:friend","name":"程雨"}]. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Character names referenced by offered choices: [{"characterId":"character:companion","name":"陆舟"}]. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Character names referenced by offered choices: [{"characterId":"character:companion","name":"陆舟"}]. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Character names referenced by offered choices: [{"characterId":"character:companion","name":"陆舟"}]. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

function.arguments: {"decision": "publish", "addresseeIds": ["character:player"], "narration": "程雨把交叠的手松开，指尖在桌沿上停了一下，没去碰日记，也没看陆舟那块表。她侧头听了听窗外的雨，又转回来。", "speech": "等车就等车。看雨，看人，看谁先不耐烦。你问这个，是想知道我会不会走？"}

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Character names referenced by offered choices: [{"characterId":"character:companion","name":"陆舟"}]. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

46d7b78","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"聊个别的话题吧，你们喜欢雨天还是晴天？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":164},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:3edc525c-dfde-40a5-8840-943adf4ea7f2:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:3edc525c-dfde-40a5-8840-943adf4ea7f2:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨从表盘上收回视线，靠回椅背，手指在桌沿上轻轻敲了一下。她没接话，先看了眼窗外的雨，又看回玩家。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"雨天。晴天太亮了，什么都看得太清楚，反而不好开口。你呢，问这个是想岔开什么？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":174},{"kind":"observation","id":"observation:scene-result:119ae3036950cc0e21432e6c","value":{"actionId":"action:dabd6cdea2f5708d71a866c6","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"平时等车的时候你们会做些什么？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":180},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:dd5aed97-3dd2-43bc-bc70-b5b3792e30ca:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:dd5aed97-3dd2-43bc-bc70-b5b3792e30ca:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨把交叠的手松开，指尖在桌沿上停了一下，没去碰日记，也没看陆舟那块表。她侧头听了听窗外的雨，又转回来。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"等车就等车。看雨，看人，看谁先不耐烦。你问这个，是想知道我会不会走？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":190},{"kind":"observation","id":"observation:scene-result:6c2a58435aa68fce1ab18c5d","value":{"actionId":"action:5d5dcaeadc4563f0941d001d","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"听一会儿雨声吧，我想歇口气。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":196},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:adf0a8a7-3f48-4658-9c5d-b79fbbd8427b:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:adf0a8a7-3f48-4658-9c5d-b79fbbd8427b:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟没接话，把怀表搁回桌上，手从表壳上收回来，靠回椅背。他侧头听窗外的雨，没再动。","replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":""},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":202}],"selfObservations":[{"observationId":"self:86","sourceSeq":86,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"放桌上也算拿着。你要看就看，别一会儿又说不算。","narration":"程雨看着那本日记被放回桌上，手没伸过去，只是把桌沿上那点节奏停了。"}},{"observationId":"self:91","sourceSeq":91,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"那块表，你也要看？","narration":"程雨看见陆舟把怀表收了过去，视线在陆舟手上停了一下，又转回桌上那本日记。她没去拦，也没催，只是把两只手交叠着放在桌沿，像在等谁先开口。"}},{"observationId":"self:113","sourceSeq":113,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"先看表吧。日记在我这儿，跑不了。","narration":"程雨低头看了眼被塞进手里的日记，指腹在布面上按了一下，没翻开。她把日记往桌上一放，手收回来，先看陆舟，再看玩家。"}},{"observationId":"self:125","sourceSeq":125,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"你拿着的，你开。我看就行。","narration":"程雨把桌上的日记往自己这边拢了拢，没翻开，两只手重新交叠在桌沿。她看着陆舟拇指底下那枚表盖，没伸手。"}},{"observationId":"self:143","sourceSeq":143,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"雨是小了点。心情……说不上来。东西都在桌上，反倒像还没开始。你们要开表，我等着。","narration":"程雨侧头听了一下窗外的雨，又看回桌上那本日记，手没动。"}},{"observationId":"self:155","sourceSeq":155,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"","narration":"程雨把交叠的手松开，身子微微前倾，视线落在表盘上。她没伸手，也没出声，先看清楚再说。"}},{"observationId":"self:172","sourceSeq":172,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"雨天。晴天太亮了，什么都看得太清楚，反而不好开口。你呢，问这个是想岔开什么？","narration":"程雨从表盘上收回视线，靠回椅背，手指在桌沿上轻轻敲了一下。她没接话，先看了眼窗外的雨，又看回玩家。"}},{"observationId":"self:188","sourceSeq":188,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"等车就等车。看雨，看人，看谁先不耐烦。你问这个，是想知道我会不会走？","narration":"程雨把交叠的手松开，指尖在桌沿上停了一下，没去碰日记，也没看陆舟那块表。她侧头听了听窗外的雨，又转回来。"}}],"claims":[],"goals":[],"items":{"current":[{"entityId":"entity:diary","holderId":"character:friend","locationId":null},{"entityId":"entity:pocket-watch","holderId":"character:companion","locationId":null}],"lastObserved":[]},"affordances":[{"actionType":"speak"},{"actionType":"move","destinations":[{"locationId":"location:back-room","name":"储藏间"}]},{"actionType":"interact","interactions":[{"arguments":{},"bindingId":"binding:diary-drop","definitionRef":{"id":"base:drop","version":1},"targetRef":{"id":"entity:diary","kind":"entity"}},{"arguments":{"recipientId":"character:companion"},"bindingId":"binding:diary-give","definitionRef":{"id":"base:give","version":1},"targetRef":{"id":"entity:diary","kind":"entity"}},{"arguments":{"recipientId":"character:player"},"bindingId":"binding:diary-give","definitionRef":{"id":"base:give","version":1},"targetRef":{"id":"entity:diary","kind":"entity"}}]}]},"continuation":false,"canPerform":true}

messages.content: Interpret only the player intent. Select exact affordances by their affordanceId. Character names referenced by offered choices: [{"characterId":"character:companion","name":"陆舟"}]. Distinguish what the player COMMUNICATES from what the player EXECUTES. A request, question or suggestion addressed to an NPC is the player speaking, not an action executed for that NPC. Select speak even if the requested NPC response has no interaction option. For example: "GPT，先不要说话，可以只用表情或手势回应我一下吗？" is speak; "GLM，你愿意去工作区吗？" is speak, not a player move. The NPC decides whether and how to respond. Use narrate for the player's own freely expressed posture, expression or other minor observable performance, even with no dialogue: "我有点尴尬地笑了笑" is narrate. It is not a claim of an adjudicated effect. For a player-executed controlled change, such as "我走到工作区" or "我把手机收进随身包由我保管", select the corresponding move/interact option. Do not hide unavailable or ambiguous controlled actions inside narrate or speak. Item interactions control custody/carrying assignment, not hand contact or legal ownership. base:take acquires custody; base:give transfers custody to another character; base:drop relinquishes personal custody and leaves the item at the location. Only select these for an intended custody change. Flipping pages, touching, sliding, briefly lifting to inspect then returning, or temporarily setting your own custodial item on a table are free narrate, without take/give/drop. Explicitly retaining custody while setting an item down means no drop. Taking an unassigned item into your travel bag to carry away means take; packing your already custodial item does not reacquire it. Bare "我拿起物品" without enough context to distinguish acquiring custody from brief handling needs clarification. Bare "我放下物品" only states physical placement, not relinquishing custody; use narrate. Do not invent another character's reaction or publish an asserted reaction as the player's performance. Copy exact source words into quotes, in source order, without rewriting or calculating offsets. Each speak or narrate publication takes one contiguous quote. At most two actions, at most one controlled world operation; a performance and dialogue may be two publications. For a performance followed by movement, put narrate before move. For example, "我轻轻笑了笑，走进后室看看有没有锁。" can use narrate quote "我轻轻笑了笑" then move quote "走进后室看看有没有锁"; the latter expresses an intention to look, not a found result. Do not attach words before and after the move to one noncontiguous narrate quote, or omit a meaningful later clause. Use free narrate instead of encoding ordinary expressions as performance cues. Only clarify when ambiguity changes an executed action/target, the player's own controlled action is unavailable, or the input cannot be interpreted reliably. A missing NPC response verb is not a reason to clarify. Answer by returning the registered tool payload only.

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

Ids":["character:companion","character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨低头看了眼被塞进手里的日记，指腹在布面上按了一下，没翻开。她把日记往桌上一放，手收回来，先看陆舟，再看玩家。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"先看表吧。日记在我这儿，跑不了。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":116},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:90bd9b38-21ad-4b76-a237-72d7c234d3e9:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:90bd9b38-21ad-4b76-a237-72d7c234d3e9:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:friend","character:player"],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟拇指抵着表盖，没开。他看了程雨一眼，又看玩家，等一个点头。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"那就开。谁先看？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":122},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:1813a603-ebac-49f5-8271-bcafc244ccd1:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:1813a603-ebac-49f5-8271-bcafc244ccd1:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:companion","character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨把桌上的日记往自己这边拢了拢，没翻开，两只手重新交叠在桌沿。她看着陆舟拇指底下那枚表盖，没伸手。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"你拿着的，你开。我看就行。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":128},{"kind":"observation","id":"observation:scene-result:a8e8ff66b8aaaafed02ebf13","value":{"actionId":"action:d46b46287862a587dfa3a6d0","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"陆舟、程雨，雨听起来小一些了吗？说说你们现在的心情。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":134},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:05e0f95c-2d29-41ad-a37a-9db6e23d5dc3:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:05e0f95c-2d29-41ad-a37a-9db6e23d5dc3:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player","character:friend"],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟侧耳听了一下窗外，雨声还在，只是比刚才闷了些。他拇指仍抵着表盖，没开。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"雨没停，小了点。心情？表还没开，有点憋。你们呢。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":140},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:340e7cd1-d4bb-4db7-892b-b98b4249cd6e:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:340e7cd1-d4bb-4db7-892b-b98b4249cd6e:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player","character:companion"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨侧头听了一下窗外的雨，又看回桌上那本日记，手没动。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"雨是小了点。心情……说不上来。东西都在桌上，反倒像还没开始。你们要开表，我等着。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":146},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:bbbc4679-6619-40c7-92f7-4aeb626418f4:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:bbbc4679-6619-40c7-92f7-4aeb626418f4:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:friend","character:player"],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟拇指一挑，表盖弹开。他没急着看，先把表往桌心挪了挪，让程雨和玩家都能看见。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"开了。都过来看。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:friend"},"sourceSeq":152},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:2b1b17bf-53aa-4b6a-9493-0a759ac6911b:0:action:observer:character:friend","value":{"actionId":"prototype- messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。

ame":"玩家"}]},"observations":[{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:05e0f95c-2d29-41ad-a37a-9db6e23d5dc3:0:action:observer:character:companion","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:05e0f95c-2d29-41ad-a37a-9db6e23d5dc3:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player","character:friend"],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟侧耳听了一下窗外，雨声还在，只是比刚才闷了些。他拇指仍抵着表盖，没开。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"雨没停，小了点。心情？表还没开，有点憋。你们呢。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:companion"},"sourceSeq":139},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:340e7cd1-d4bb-4db7-892b-b98b4249cd6e:0:action:observer:character:companion","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:340e7cd1-d4bb-4db7-892b-b98b4249cd6e:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player","character:companion"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨侧头听了一下窗外的雨，又看回桌上那本日记，手没动。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"雨是小了点。心情……说不上来。东西都在桌上，反倒像还没开始。你们要开表，我等着。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:companion"},"sourceSeq":145},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:bbbc4679-6619-40c7-92f7-4aeb626418f4:0:action:observer:character:companion","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:bbbc4679-6619-40c7-92f7-4aeb626418f4:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:friend","character:player"],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟拇指一挑，表盖弹开。他没急着看，先把表往桌心挪了挪，让程雨和玩家都能看见。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"开了。都过来看。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:companion"},"sourceSeq":151},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:2b1b17bf-53aa-4b6a-9493-0a759ac6911b:0:action:observer:character:companion","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:2b1b17bf-53aa-4b6a-9493-0a759ac6911b:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:companion","character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨把交叠的手松开，身子微微前倾，视线落在表盘上。她没伸手，也没出声，先看清楚再说。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":""},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:companion"},"sourceSeq":157},{"kind":"observation","id":"observation:scene-result:04241d8f4ea7650b4996e0ae","value":{"actionId":"action:2f138da8e44cc6b4e46d7b78","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"聊个别的话题吧，你们喜欢雨天还是晴天？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:companion"},"sourceSeq":163},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:4e54b5f3-f564-4a36-b08b-dd6dd82e50aa:0:action:observer:character:companion","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:4e54b5f3-f564-4a36-b08b-dd6dd82e50aa:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player"],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟没把表盖上，手还搭在表壳边，视线从表盘抬起来。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"雨天。雨声盖住别的动静，好办事。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:companion"},"sourceSeq":169},{"kind":"observation","id":"observation:scene-result:3edcab653dbf26156264cd01","value":{"actionId":"action:dabd6cdea2f5708d71a866c6","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"平时等车的时候你们会做些什么？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:companion"},"sourceSeq":179},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:67280d88-df52-42a4-be2d-03c0dc4ab7cc:0:action:observer:character:companion","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:67280d88-df52-42a4-be2d-03c0dc4ab7cc:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:player"],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟把表盖合上，铜壳在指间转了半圈，没往兜里收。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"等车就坐着。看人，看表。偶尔翻两页东西。你呢？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:companion"},"sourceSeq":185},{"kind":"observation","id":"observation:scene-result:db247941506a55e5441e05da","value":{"actionId":"action:5d5dcaeadc4563f0941d001d","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"听一会儿雨声吧，我想歇口气。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:companion"},"sourceSeq":195},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:adf0a8a7-3f48-4658-9c5d-b79fbbd8427b:0:action:observer:character:companion","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:adf0a8a7-3f48-4658-9c5d-b79fbbd8427b:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟没接话，把怀表搁回桌上，手从表壳上收回来，靠回椅背。他侧头听窗外的雨，没再动。","replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":""},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:companion"},"sourceSeq":201},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:25e77b33-a310-422b-bede-f8aa1efcd709:0:action:observer:character:companion","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:25e77b33-a310-422b-bede-f8aa1efcd709:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨没接话，靠回椅背，视线落在窗外。雨声比刚才匀了些，她听着，手指在桌沿上停了，没再敲。桌上那本日记还在她手边，她没去碰。","replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":""},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:companion"},"sourceSeq":207},{"kind":"observation","id":"observation:scene-result:c75a58ee13601d32f1bbf2e2","value":{"actionId":"action:d1221555001cac73beb02a6c","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"程雨，你可以把自己保管的布面日记暂放桌上，腾出手整理衣袖，不用改变保管人。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:companion"},"sourceSeq":213},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:e7af0c62-a72f-41be-9817-9a26a3e8a58e:0:action:observer:character:companion","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:e7af0c62-a72f-41be-9817-9a26a3e8a58e:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨听完，低头看了眼手边的日记，把它往桌心推了半寸，手收回来搭在桌沿。她没去整理衣袖，只是看着玩家。","replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"放桌上我照做。不过你特意说一句\"不用改变保管人\"，是怕我多想，还是你自己在数着？"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:companion"},"sourceSeq":219},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:9cd83eaf-faf7-40fc-bad7-c1ff5e0230c6:0:action:observer:character:companion","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:9cd83eaf-faf7-40fc-bad7-c1ff5e0230c6:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:companion","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:friend","character:player"],"characterId":"character:companion","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"陆舟没接程雨那句，视线在她推出去半寸的日记上停了一下，又收回来。他靠回椅背，手搭在桌沿，没去碰怀表。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"你们俩的事，我不数。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:companion"},"sourceSeq":225},{"kind":"observation","id":"prototype-turn:cba014a8-01df-4d2e-900f-3275460f7a78:0:action:observer:character:companion","value":{"actionId":"prototype-turn:cba014a8-01df-4d2e-900f-3275460f7a78:0:action","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:friend","resultDescription":"这次行动已经成功执行。当前状态请以本次可见场景为准。","speech":{"addresseeIds":["character:companion","character:player"],"characterId":"character:friend","declaredSpeechAct":null,"narration":"程雨听完，没立刻回。她看了眼陆舟搭在桌沿的手，又看回自己推出去半寸的日记，指尖在桌沿上轻轻压了一下。","replyTo":null,"scope":"direct","text":"不数就好。那这本日记，我先拿着。等雨停之前，谁想翻，说一声。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:companion"},"sourceSeq":231},{"kind":"observation","id":"observation:scene-result:7c92b98e872a4a73a77f7584","value":{"actionId":"action:6e52fb35bb804960a9aaa844","content":{"actionType":"speak","actorId":"character:player","reason":null,"speech":{"addresseeIds":[],"characterId":"character:player","declaredSpeechAct":null,"replyTo":null,"scope":"scene_public","text":"陆舟，麻烦把布面日记交给我，方便我收台。"},"status":"accepted"},"observerId":"character:companion"},"sourceSeq":237}],"selfObservations":[{"observationId":"self:107","sourceSeq":107,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"日记给她了。表还在这儿。开不开，你们说。","narration":"陆舟看见日记被递到程雨手里，没插话。他把怀表在掌心又转了半圈，拇指抵住表盖，抬眼看了看程雨，又看了看玩家。"}},{"observationId":"self:119","sourceSeq":119,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"那就开。谁先看？","narration":"陆舟拇指抵着表盖，没开。他看了程雨一眼，又看玩家，等一个点头。"}},{"observationId":"self:137","sourceSeq":137,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"雨没停，小了点。心情？表还没开，有点憋。你们呢。","narration":"陆舟侧耳听了一下窗外，雨声还在，只是比刚才闷了些。他拇指仍抵着表盖，没开。"}},{"observationId":"self:149","sourceSeq":149,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"开了。都过来看。","narration":"陆舟拇指一挑，表盖弹开。他没急着看，先把表往桌心挪了挪，让程雨和玩家都能看见。"}},{"observationId":"self:167","sourceSeq":167,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"雨天。雨声盖住别的动静，好办事。","narration":"陆舟没把表盖上，手还搭在表壳边，视线从表盘抬起来。"}},{"observationId":"self:183","sourceSeq":183,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"等车就坐着。看人，看表。偶尔翻两页东西。你呢？","narration":"陆舟把表盖合上，铜壳在指间转了半圈，没往兜里收。"}},{"observationId":"self:199","sourceSeq":199,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"","narration":"陆舟没接话，把怀表搁回桌上，手从表壳上收回来，靠回椅背。他侧头听窗外的雨，没再动。"}},{"observationId":"self:223","sourceSeq":223,"content":{"actionType":"speak","text":"你们俩的事，我不数。","narration":"陆舟没接程雨那句，视线在她推出去半寸的日记上停了一下，又收回来。他靠回椅背，手搭在桌沿，没去碰怀表。"}}],"claims":[],"goals":[],"items":{"current":[{"entityId":"entity:diary","holderId":"character:friend","locationId":null},{"entityId":"entity:pocket-watch","holderId":"character:companion","locationId":null}],"lastObserved":[]},"affordances":[{"actionType":"speak"},{"actionType":"move","destinations":[{"locationId":"location:back-room","name":"储藏间"}]},{"actionType":"interact","interactions":[{"arguments":{},"bindingId":"binding:key-drop","definitionRef":{"id":"base:drop","version":1},"targetRef":{"id":"entity:pocket-watch","kind":"entity"}},{"arguments":{"recipientId":"character:friend"},"bindingId":"binding:key-give","definitionRef":{"id":"base:give","version":1},"targetRef":{"id":"entity:pocket-watch","kind":"entity"}},{"arguments":{"recipientId":"character:player"},"bindingId":"binding:key-give","definitionRef":{"id":"base:give","version":1},"targetRef":{"id":"entity:pocket-watch","kind":"entity"}}]}]},"continuation":false,"canPerform":true}

messages.content: 扮演场景中的这个角色，依据自己的性格和可见信息自主决定。被唤醒只是处理新信息的机会，不要求你表演回应。没有要补充的内容时返回 abstain，不发布任何表达。有意义的沉默、微笑、注视属于表达，可以 publish 自由 narration；对白用 speech。物品 holderId 表示当前保管、携带和转交关系，不表示手是否碰到物品，也不表示所有权。null 表示尚未由个人保管、留在 locationId 所示场所。base:take 是纳入自己保管，base:give 是转交保管，base:drop 是解除个人保管并留在当前场所。这些迁移须 perform。翻页、触碰、挪动、临时托起查看再放回可以自由表达；把自己保管的物品暂放桌上不自动解除保管。收进随身口袋带走则改变保管关系。涉及已声明的重要交互或移动时选择 perform，不能用叙述代替执行，也不要提前描写成功后的情节。perform 的参数来自可尝试选项，结果由世界裁定。执行后会给你真实成功或失败结果与刷新后的场景。一次激活最多尝试两次重要交互；仅在本次工具契约仍提供 perform 时才能再次请求。没有 perform 时只能 publish 或 abstain。表达不能改变受控状态或替别人决定反应。
